title: Product of array except self
statement: Return an array where element i is the product of every element of nums except nums[i], without using division, in O(n) time. Products fit in 64 bits.
hints: Product of everything to the left times product of everything to the right.
Fill the output with prefix products in one pass, then multiply in suffix products in a second pass.
complexity: O(n) time, O(1) extra besides the output

solution.explanation: out[i] = (product of nums[0..i−1]) × (product of nums[i+1..]). One forward pass writes the prefix products, one backward pass multiplies by a running suffix product. No division, so zeros need no special case.
solution.python:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums); out = [1] * n
    p = 1
    for i in range(n): out[i] = p; p *= nums[i]
    p = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1): out[i] *= p; p *= nums[i]
    return out
